en: A sepia-toned postcard with two photographs: on the left, a large guesthouse-style villa built on a stone foundation with several stories, dormer windows, and surrounding countryside buildings; on the right, a woman in a patterned dress stands in a doorway holding two trays of food, smiling toward the camera. Printed German text at the lower right advertises a pension called "Lichtenhöh" and gives the proprietor's name, town, and telephone number.
